## What

BL-98 / REQ-PANE-1 (RV-31, cut from `229_R7PANE.1`'s scope): the IDE right-panel split persists across sessions — and double-clicking the `[data-ide-handle]` divider snaps it back to the default. Persistence rides the existing `rhema:panes:v2:<user>:<project>` localStorage seam R7PANE.1 landed (`commit()` → `serializePaneState`); no second store, no twin write.

The persistence half mostly existed — the drag's pointerup already ran `commit(paneDrag(...))`, which wrote `panelWidth` into the blob. The real gap: the codec always serialized a `panelWidth`, so a "reset" could only ever write `320` back — the pref was never truly *cleared*. `panelWidth` now takes `panelOpen`'s three-state shape: `panelWidth?: number`, absent ⇒ `DEFAULT_PANEL_WIDTH` (320, exported from `packages/ide`) at every read site. A double-click commits `{panelWidth: undefined}` — the key **leaves the blob entirely**.

## Shape

- `packages/ide/src/layout.ts` — `DEFAULT_PANEL_WIDTH = 320`; `panelWidth?: number` (absent ⇒ default, the `panelOpen` precedent); `pageChFor` falls back.
- `packages/ide/src/state.ts` — `DEFAULT_PANE_STATE` drops the key; v2 parse keeps an absent key absent (a stored number still clamps 160–480); v1 migration keeps a concrete width; serialize never re-emits a cleared key.
- `apps/web/src/spa/ide/controller.ts` — `?? DEFAULT_PANEL_WIDTH` at the three read sites (`--panel-w`, `aria-valuenow`, arrow-key step) + a delegated `dblclick` listener on `[data-ide-handle]`: docked ⇒ `commit({panelWidth: undefined})`; overlay/sheet ⇒ session-scoped `stateRef` reset + `apply()` — the drag's REQ-PANE-2 arm mirrored exactly (never persisted from overlay mode).
- `packages/ui/src/ide-shell.tsx` + `apps/web/src/copy.ts` — `title={L.panel.resizeReset}` on the separator ("Drag to resize · double-click for the default split") for discoverability. `data-ide-handle`/`role="separator"`/aria range byte-identical — occlusion selectors unchanged.
- ReadOnly/demo: the demo boot writes the same local pref (`rhema:panes:v2:demo:<p>`) with zero non-GET requests — visual persistence only.

## Tests

- `packages/ide/src/ide.test.ts` — absent `panelWidth` lays out at the default; three-state serialize/parse round-trip; a cleared split never re-serializes; out-of-range stored width still clamps (36/36).
- `apps/web/src/spa/ide-chrome.dom.test.tsx` — BL-98 describe (5 legs, happy-dom): drag end writes `panelWidth` + stamps `--panel-w`/`aria-valuenow`; a remount renders the stored split; dblclick restores 320 **and the key leaves the blob** (an unrelated commit never re-creates it; a remount stays 320); dblclick with no pref is harmless; at 1100px overlay the drag+reset stay session-scoped (blob untouched); demo boot writes `paneStorageKey("demo", …)` with zero non-GET fetches (47/47 file-wide).
- `packages/ui` / fixtures — `IdeLabels.panel.resizeReset` added to the type + the three literal label fixtures.
